items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: you couldn't help but be somewhat influenced by what he did.

ctx.x: Now what about Louie Armstrong? What impact did he have on you, for example, in the recordings you might have heard of him or indeed, have heard him in New York?
Well, when I first heard Armstrong, I

was just as impressed as everyone else was; he was just great, you know? He had a great influence on everybody. I mean, no matter what instrument you were playing, if you were playing what we thought of as jazz or what was called 'jazz' -- you couldn't help but be somewhat influenced by what he did.
